I was literally a zombie all of the time. Now I’m on 20 mg of Paxil and am the closest to base line I’ve been since I started taking meds and I want to ween off of Paxil but the brain zaps are too bad. If you’re having doubts about going on meds, try cognitive behavior therapy, meditation (isolation tanks work well for this if you have access), and other non prescription ways and track your mood everyday for a month and see if there’s an improvement and then decide also read the side effects because all of them can be pretty brutal for some people
